overview: A full set of tools crafted from smooth quartz blocks. They hit harder and mine faster than diamond and take enchantments exceptionally well, but they are fragile.

2.1.0: With Smithing Templates installed, quartz tools take trims at the smithing table, and the trim shows on the tool.
2.0.2: The mod menu icon matches the one on the download pages.
2.0.1: Quartz mines faster than netherite without mining faster than everything.
2.0.0: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and sword, with an advancement for each recipe.
A quartz tool in hand is what unlocks the rest.
